location: Bruxelles-Midi / Brussel-Zuid, Avenue Fonsny administrative/postal frontage

source.publisher: Inventaire du patrimoine architectural, Région de Bruxelles-Capitale
source.title: Gare du Midi et bâtiments annexes
facts_used: The three administrative and postal buildings on Avenue Fonsny use aluminium window frames.
The windows are described with a fixed lower section and tilting transom.
A sunshade is documented as part of the window composition.

runtime_scope.geometry: existing authored Fonsny office window planes only; no station massing or Centre geometry replacement
runtime_scope.placement: frames/transoms/sunshades are derived from the positions of existing Window_* nodes in each office block

authored_not_measured: exact aluminium colour, metallic response and roughness
licensing: Original runtime primitives and material. No source photograph, logo, font or third-party texture is distributed.
reuse_policy: Reuse only where an independent source confirms aluminium window framing or comparable metal sunshade construction.
